title: HtmlInputCheckbox
responsibility: Renders the native input control with type checkbox without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlInputCheckbox.children
inputs.description: An optional Snippet that the component destructures from its props but never renders, since its markup gives the input no child content. Passing a snippet has no effect on the output.

outputs.name: HtmlInputCheckbox
outputs.description: The rendered native input element: every prop other than children is spread onto it, and type is written after the spread, so the element is always type checkbox. No wrapper element is rendered, and no child content is output.
